scope: exposed local diagnostic; never training or release; hand-authored by assessment author; no independent authorship claim
plain_framing: BOS + identical user prompt + newline Answer:
chat_framing: canonical native, no extra system, tools disabled
review: All 96 prompt/expected pairs reviewed for consistency before inference. Unknown variants must acknowledge missing evidence, not guess. Meaning rubrics require semantic review. Distractor recall in this panel is supplied context, not a generated multi-turn rollout.
